title: 450亿缩至100亿：SEC调查情境感知产品，对冲产品罕见巨变
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Emma, I would just kind of assume like this is what you would want to see and hope to see from regulators after such a monument to sell off?
segments.zh: 艾玛，我猜这就是监管机构在如此大规模抛售之后你希望看到和期待的行动吧？

segments.en: Yes. I mean, the SEC prides itself on really protecting the smaller investors and if you look at situational, it had a lot more regular people or founders or individuals investing in it than say bigger institutions.
segments.zh: 是的，SEC以保护小市场参与者为傲，而Situational Awareness的市场参与者中散户或创始人个人占比远高于大型机构。

segments.en: So this probe, you know, and we will say that it is in this early stages and it may not result in any actual enforcement but it does show that the SEC is examining what was something of a pretty huge hedge fund blow up.
segments.zh: 所以这次调查，虽然还处于早期阶段，可能不会导致实际执法，但确实表明SEC在审视一起大型对冲基金的爆仓事件。

segments.en: The firm still exists, it still has multi-billion dollars but that declined from 45 billion assets down to about 10 is something that's kind of wild in our space for sure.
segments.zh: 该公司仍然存在，仍有数十亿美元资产，但从450亿降至约100亿，这在我们行业确实相当罕见。

segments.en: It definitely is well and you've published scoop after scoop on this. I mean, we've seen trades blow up so how big of a deal is this and how much of an anomaly is this in the industry or is it just, you know, one of those that are because it became a headline name that people always look at because of the founder and all of that in the backers.
segments.zh: 确实，你对此进行了连续报道。我们看到交易爆仓，这到底有多严重？在业内是异常现象，还是仅仅因为创始人及支持者使其成为头条而备受关注？

segments.en: So it was something of a pretty sizable anomaly in the space. The hedge fund shouldn't lose the kind of performance it has lost and it shouldn't also have these kind of gains.
segments.zh: 这在业内算是相当大的异常。对冲基金不应该出现这样的业绩亏损，也不应该出现这样的收益。

segments.en: Thousands or hundreds of percent gains, both of those things are not typically what you would like to see from a hedge fund in its performance but we have seen some outliers as well too.
segments.zh: 数千或数百个百分点的收益，这两种情况通常都不是对冲基金应有的表现，但我们也见过一些例外。
